'''Saki Shrine''' (さきじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Nishihata, aza Saki-chō (さきちょう), {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Saki-chō}}, {{ill|Nara (city)|Q169134|qid=Q169134}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. Its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=village shrine}}{{sfn|奈良県史|p=28}}.

=== History ===
Its historical transition is unclear, but it is said to have been divided and transferred in the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}} from {{ill|Saki Shrine|Q56346760|qid=Q56346760|lt=Saki Shrine}} in Kamehata{{sfn|奈良市史|p=305}}.
It is the tutelary shrine of Saki Nishi-chō (former Nishihata village), and the parishioner area is Nishihata, aza Saki-chō, west of the shrine.
There is a miyaza system of upper six households and lower six households; with neighboring {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tsuridono Shrine}} (former tutelary shrine of Mongaimura), it has nearly the same enshrined deities and miyaza system, and the branch-establishment period is also thought to be around the Edo period.
Before that, the origin is said to be the subsidiary Ōkuninushi Shrine of Saki Shrine.
Tradition says that repeated power struggles between Nijō village and Nishihata village led it to begin calling itself Saki Shrine.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* {{ill|Futsunushi|lt=Futsunushi|Q1107286|qid=Q1107286|qid=Q1107286|lt=Futsunushi-no-Mikoto}} - enshrined at the center of the honden{{sfn|奈良市史|p=304}}.
* {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}} - enshrined on the right side of the honden{{sfn|奈良市史|p=304}}.
* Six Mikata Deities - enshrined on the left side of the honden{{sfn|奈良市史|p=304}}. They are regarded as deities seated in the six mikata of Takachi, Katsuraki, Tōchi, Shiki, Yamabe, and Sofu{{sfn|奈良市史|p=304}}.

=== Precinct ===
[[File:Saki Shrine (Nara, Nishihata) Haiden.jpg|thumb|200px|Haiden]]
=== Honden ===
An ikken-sha {{ill|Nagare-zukuri|Q210684|qid=Q210684}} with cypress-bark roofing{{sfn|奈良市史|p=304}}.

=== Haiden ===
{{ill|East Asian hip-and-gable roof|Q855025|qid=Q855025}} with tiled roof, measuring three ken by two ken, with boarded flooring{{sfn|奈良市史|p=304}}.

=== Water basin ===
It bears an inscription dated year 4 of {{ill|Kaei|Q1146125|qid=Q1146125}} ({{ill|1851|Q7656|qid=Q7656}}){{sfn|奈良市史|p=304}}.
